title: PIR Detection Zone Map
description: Why a PIR sensor sees someone walking across a room and misses someone standing still in front of it.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a PIR sensor's detection zones and a person's walking path, the learner explains why crossing zone boundaries triggers detection while standing still within one zone does not.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover any marker to compare the two walking paths against the zone pattern
pedagogical.assessment: Predict which of two described paths triggers the sensor.
